current_title: SD-033a metric-redesign falsifier: direct rule_state cosine probes on held-out rule-context pairs (replaces 598b reef-visit-band behavioural metric). Teleport-sampled reef-context vs forage-context observation pool drives the rule_state EMA via the real sense->select_action->lateral_pfc.update path under sustained context; mean-centered cosine (RSA) measures rule_state context-discriminability. Independent of the blocked ARC-065/GAP-B behavioural-diversity work (random/teleport sampling sidesteps monomodal collapse). Same-statistic z_world discriminability is the non-vacuity readiness precondition.
